items.title: R.C.H. Smith Interview, 1975-10-02
items.q: But playing jazz, the Laori conceived it.

ctx.x: But when I met him, he still struck me. And he was still a handsome, personable guy, even though he was old and weak. Definitely.

I would call it... He had a lot of sparkle. You know, there was a twinkle in those kiddish eyes of his. You know, and there was a lot of vitality in his movements. He used to wear him out. You know, we only played the two nights a week. It was his club, and he could call the shots as he wished. And business, I think, was such that he was wise. He stayed open on Friday and Saturday nights only. Didn't have to worry about bartender payrolls and all that sort of thing during the early part of the week when you would…
We were talking earlier, and I'd like to get you placed in your age and everything. When's your birthday?
